scope: Facilitated Collier 2027 factual research; no ranking, quote, enrollment or exact clinical network confirmation

facts.text: Original Medicare consists of Parts A and B. Part D is prescription drug coverage, offered separately or through a Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage.
support: Original Medicare includes Part A and Part B.
Part D helps cover the cost of prescription drugs.

facts.text: Medicare Advantage is a private-plan alternative for receiving Medicare benefits. It usually includes drug coverage; provider networks and prior authorization may apply.
support: Medicare Advantage offers an alternative to Original Medicare
prior authorization

facts.text: Medigap is supplemental insurance for cost sharing under Original Medicare. The demo has no personal Medigap quote or underwriting decision.
support: extra insurance you may be able to buy
out-of-pocket costs in Original Medicare

facts.text: Prior authorization means a plan requires approval under its rules before covering certain medicines. A formulary listing does not confirm that approval for a person.
support: Prior authorization is approval based on a plan

facts.text: Step therapy can require trying another listed medicine first. Your prescriber can help request an exception; this assistant does not choose substitute treatment.
support: Step therapy is a type of prior authorization
ask for an exception to step therapy

facts.text: A plan can restrict the amount of a medicine covered over time. The actual unit, quantity and days supply must be checked for the exact product.
support: Plans may limit the amount of drugs they cover

facts.text: NCH announces that Cigna/HealthSpring and Wellcare Medicare Advantage plans will be out of network beginning January 1, 2027. This notice concerns Medicare Advantage, not standalone drug plans.
support: Beginning January 1, 2027, NCH will no longer accept
Cigna/HealthSpring Medicare Advantage plans and Wellcare Medicare Advantage plans.
